ⓓ REAR WIPER RELAY
1-GROUND: 12 VOLTS WITH IGNITION S/W ON
3-GROUND: 12 VOLTS EVERY 12 SECONDS INTERMITTENTLY WITH IGNITION S/W ON AND WIPER S/W AT INT POSITION
3-GROUND: 12 VOLTS WITH IGNITION S/W AND WASHER S/W ON AND FOR 4 SECONDS AFTER WASHER S/W TURNED OFF
2-GROUND: 12 VOLTS WITH IGNITION S/W ON UNLESS WIPER MOTOR AT STOP POSITION
3-GROUND: 12 VOLTS WITH IGNITION S/W ON AND AFTER WIPER S/W OFF UNTIL WIPER MOTOR STOPS
